## MKV Track Organizer 1.0.18

This release adds the first automatic dependency installer.

### Added

- **Install/Update selected** support for `seconv` in the Config tab Dependency Manager.
- Automatic architecture selection between `SeConv-Windows-x64.zip` and `SeConv-Windows-ARM64.zip`.
- Safe local install into `_tools\seconv`, which is already part of the Organizer tool discovery path.

### Notes

- Automatic installs are intentionally limited to supported tools for now. Other dependencies still show status and open their official download pages.
